```{r cars, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
library(daff)
y <- iris[1:3,]
x <- y

x <- head(x,2) # remove a row
x[1,1] <- 10 # change a value
x[3,1] <- 10 # change a value
x[2,3] <- 1522540 # change a value
x[3,3] <- 1522540 # change a value
x$hello <- "world"  # add a column
x$hfadello <- "fg"  # add a column
x$Species <- x$Species |> as.character()
x$Species[2] <- "dfsNULL" # remove a column
# x <- dplyr::bind_rows(data.frame(Species = "uyfia"), x)
patch <- diff_data(y, x)

# write a patch to disk
a <- render_diff(patch, title = NULL, summary = F, use.DataTables = F)

ht <- rvest::read_html(a)
h3 <- xml2::xml_find_all(ht, '//html/body/h3')
xml2::xml_remove(h3)
html <- xml2::xml_find_all(ht, '//html')

a2 <- as.character(html)

# https://github.com/edwindj/daff/issues/3#issuecomment-330633694
wrapDaffHTML <- function(chunkHTML, chunkTitle) {
cat("<div class='highlighter' style='align:center;'>")
  # font-size:80%;'>
cat(chunkHTML)
cat("</div><br><br>")
}
wrapDaffHTML(a2, "a")
```
